description.value: Giovane Caffè is an Italian coffee bar situated inside the Fairmont Pacific Rim on West Cordova Street, offering espresso drinks prepared to Italian tradition alongside panini, salads, and aperitivi. Cyclists can grab a quick bite to go or settle in at indoor or outdoor seating. It is part of the KT Restaurant Group and is one of two Vancouver locations.

address.value: 1049 West Cordova Street, Vancouver, BC V6C 0B9
